description: Test of containers that hand their contents over when opened: a PIN dispenser with one item, a password dispenser with two, and a dispenser that holds a fixture it cannot hand over, so it falls back to the container screen. Nothing to solve beyond the codes.
test_objective: Prove a container marked dispenses puts its items straight into the inventory with one toast when the PIN or password is accepted, never twice on a fast second press, and opens the container screen instead when any item cannot be handed over
